title: Ninja Forms Troubleshooting
description: Fix forms not submitting, email actions failing, validation errors, and conflicts with cache or security plugins.

steps.title: Identify Form Failure Type
steps.instructions: Note if the form does not load, submit button spins forever, validation blocks submission, emails never arrive, or submissions missing in admin.

steps.title: Check Browser Console and Network Tab
steps.instructions: Submit the form with DevTools open. Look for 403/500 on admin-ajax.php or REST endpoints. Note nonce failures or blocked scripts.

steps.title: Debug Email Actions
steps.instructions: Review form Actions → Email. Confirm To/From addresses, use SMTP plugin for delivery, and check WP Mail Logging for send failures.

steps.title: Audit Required Fields and Conditional Logic
steps.instructions: Hidden required fields or broken conditional logic can block submission silently. Test with all fields visible and simplify conditions temporarily.

steps.title: Exclude Forms from Cache and Security Rules
steps.instructions: Page cache may serve stale nonces. Exclude form pages from cache. Whitelist admin-ajax.php in Wordfence or similar if submissions return 403.

steps.title: Update Ninja Forms and Add-ons Together
steps.instructions: Mismatched core and add-on versions cause JS errors. Update all Ninja Forms extensions or deactivate add-ons one by one to find conflicts.

steps.title: Check Akismet, reCAPTCHA, and Honeypot Settings
steps.instructions: Over-aggressive spam protection can reject legitimate submissions. Test with spam modules disabled, then re-enable with correct API keys.

steps.title: Submit Test Entry and Confirm Delivery
steps.instructions: Submit from front end and confirm success message, entry in Ninja Forms → Submissions, and email receipt. Test on mobile if reported mobile-only issues.
